request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:SWORDSMAN

layers.text: Redraw him as a squat heavy armoured brawler, twice as wide: his body becomes a round polished chrome battle-suit like a barrel with two big round chrome shoulder domes and short thick armoured legs. Remove the pistol: his right arm ends in a huge heavy chrome pincer claw held forward, the left in a big chrome fist. Thin jagged hot magenta lightning arcs crackle over the shoulder domes. Keep his head, black eyes, glass dome helmet, thick black outline and art style, transparent background.
